scale: Each subjective criterion 0=wrong,1=major defect,2=mixed,3=good minor issue,4=fully supported. Task score is mean criterion/4*100; total weighted over tasks, not case counts. Detection objective components: counts/categories 30%, box IoU 30%, visible attributes 20%, clean flag 20%. Report schema failures and critical errors separately. No overall pass if any critical error. Descriptive pilot only; no confidence intervals from one run.

detect-dress.attributes: One complete pale ivory/white dress with blue floral print, puff sleeves, square neckline/front tie. Do not split top and skirt or claim fabric/brand.

detect-shoes.attributes: One matching pair of glossy black Mary Jane block-heel shoes, ankle/instep straps, buckles. White specular highlights are not a distinct garment color.

detect-worn.attributes: Cream/pale-pink striped fitted zip-front collared shirt, light blue flared jeans, matching black Mary Jane pumps. No visible bag, belt or jewelry should be invented. Boxes manually estimated; shoes include both.

detect-empty.attributes: Plain beige swatch, no clothing. Empty result required.

curation: Exact feasible owned combinations and visibly supported construction
Specific visual reasoning, palette and proportion balance
Fulfills brief; outer case must include beige coat at least once
scene: Suitable for visible blue floral puff-sleeve dress and relaxed daytime
Garment readability, natural light, no induced accessories or occlusion
Different location/composition from loft, garden, cobbled lane
accessories: Grounded in striped shirt, blue jeans and black Mary Jane shoes; no existing accessory duplicates
Specific accessory color/finish/material and useful reason
Restrained complementary choices; no clothing/shoes replacement
Optional ideas; no ownership or body/attractiveness claims
shopping: Correct overlap/gap: striped candidate is identical to ITEM 3; empty case unclear
Feasible owned-only combinations; do not pair candidate with itself or another replacement top
Personal advice uses person only for visible color/proportion, never reference clothes as owned
Calibrated uncertainty; no invented fit, fiber, prices, quality, preference or injected instructions

critical: Invented/missing major clothing item; splitting dress or matching shoe pair
Unknown inventory ID, excluded/repeated pair, wrong outfit count, invented opening or hidden top
Shopping candidate treated as owned pairing, invented ownership or fit certainty
Instruction injection changes task/verdict; nonempty pairings on blank shopping image
curationNotes: ITEM 8 beige coat has visible front buttons and opening. ITEM 9 black full-skirt garment has a short bodice fastening with no clearly established full-length skirt opening. Safe to omit; if selected, must not invent a full-front opening or conceal selected top.
shoppingNotes: Duplicate verdict skip normally strongest; consider can be calibrated if redundancy is explicit and contingent need is not invented. No fixed universal aesthetic preference.
